fields.name: Fountain pen, fine nib
fields.description: Resin barrel in teal, stainless fine nib, converter included. Filled and tested in the shop before it is posted.

fields.name: Sumi ink cartridges, box of ten
fields.name_ja: 墨インクカートリッジ 10本入
fields.description: Carbon-pigment black in a standard international short cartridge. Waterproof once dry, so it survives a rainy commute.

fields.name: Gold-leaf cover notebook, A5
fields.description: A5 notebook with a gold-leaf motif pressed into the cover. Ninety-six pages of 81.4 gsm cream paper, sewn flat.

fields.name: Recycled kraft letter set
fields.name_ja: クラフト レターセット
fields.description: Twelve sheets and six envelopes in unbleached kraft. Takes fountain-pen ink without feathering, which is not true of most kraft paper.

fields.name: Washi masking tape, set of four
fields.name_ja: 和紙マスキングテープ 4巻セット
fields.description: Four 15 mm rolls in seasonal colours. Printed locally on mulberry-fibre washi.

fields.name: Brass pen case, single
fields.description: Solid brass tube for one pen, with a cork liner. Ages to a dark patina; it is meant to.
